items.title: Mona Hinton interviewed by Milt Fillius and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: acted as a business advisor to Count Basie as well as music contractor for Lena Horne... Yes, I’m the co-executor of Basie’s estate

ctx.x: Now am I correct that you are, were involved with the Basie estate?
Yes, I’m the co-executor of Basie’s estate and his wife’s estate, and the co-guardian of his daughter Diane.
His daughter’s still in a home?
